title: What If You Could Pause Everyone But You? ⏱️ #Shorts
description:
What if you could pause time for everyone on Earth except you? ⏱️

Sounds like the ultimate superpower until real physics kicks in... If time stops, light stops moving. You are pitch black blind. And air freezes into solid walls.

Who is going to unfreeze you?

Subscribe to @WhatIfDaily for weekly animated thought experiments!
